name: Gradient Calculation for Global Illumination
aliases: Analytical Gradient Derivation for Gaussian Surfels
definition: An explicit gradient derivation method for optimization, showing duality between forward pass and backward pass, allowing non-recursive analytical definitions of gradients for emissions, materials, and geometry.
summary: Gradient Calculation for Global Illumination analytically derives gradients for 3D Gaussian surfels, offering a non-recursive, efficient alternative to automatic differentiation by exploiting light transport duality.
